title: Murder
punishment: Death or life imprisonment and fine

title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
description: Punishes culpable homicide not amounting to murder.
punishment: Up to life imprisonment or up to 10 years and fine

title: Attempt to murder
punishment: Up to 10 years or life imprisonment and fine

title: Rape
description: Defines and punishes the offense of rape.
punishment: Minimum 7 years, may extend to life imprisonment

title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
punishment: Up to 7 years and fine

title: Cruelty by husband or relatives
description: Punishes cruelty against a married woman.
punishment: Up to 3 years and fine

title: Assault on woman with intent to outrage modesty
description: Punishes assault or criminal force against a woman with intent to outrage modesty.
punishment: Up to 5 years and fine

title: Criminal breach of trust
punishment: Up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Criminal conspiracy
punishment: Depends on conspiracy offense

title: Common intention
description: Joint liability for acts done in furtherance of common intention.
punishment: Same as main offense

title: Rioting
punishment: Up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Rioting with deadly weapon
description: Punishes rioting while armed with a deadly weapon.
punishment: Up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Unlawful assembly
description: Liability for offenses committed by members of an unlawful assembly.
punishment: Same as main offense

title: Obstructing public servant
description: Punishes obstruction of a public servant in discharge of duties.
punishment: Up to 3 months or fine or both

title: Obscene acts
description: Punishes obscene acts or songs in public.
punishment: Up to 3 months or fine or both

title: Voluntarily causing hurt
punishment: Up to 1 year or fine or both

title: Hurt by dangerous weapons
description: Punishes voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons.
punishment: Up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Grievous hurt
punishment: Up to 7 years and fine

title: Theft
punishment: Up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Theft in dwelling house
description: Punishes theft in a dwelling house.
punishment: Up to 7 years and fine

title: Robbery
punishment: Up to 10 years and fine

title: Dacoity
punishment: Life imprisonment or up to 10 years and fine

title: Robbery with attempt to cause death
description: Punishes robbery with attempt to cause death or grievous hurt.
punishment: Minimum 7 years

title: Preparing for dacoity
punishment: Up to 10 years and fine

title: Receiving stolen property
punishment: Up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Habitually dealing in stolen property
description: Punishes habitual dealing in stolen property.
punishment: Life imprisonment or up to 10 years and fine

title: Cheating definition
punishment: Definition only

title: Criminal trespass
punishment: Definition only

title: Punishment for criminal trespass
punishment: Up to 3 months or fine or both

title: House trespass
punishment: Up to 1 year or fine or both

title: Forgery
punishment: Definition only

title: Punishment for forgery
punishment: Up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Forgery for purpose of cheating
punishment: Up to 7 years and fine

title: Using forged document
description: Punishes using a forged document as genuine.
punishment: Same as forgery offense

title: Counterfeiting currency
description: Punishes counterfeiting of currency or bank notes.
punishment: Life imprisonment or up to 10 years and fine

title: Defamation
punishment: Up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Criminal intimidation
punishment: Definition only

title: Punishment for criminal intimidation
punishment: Up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Word or gesture insulting modesty of a woman
description: Punishes words or gestures intended to insult a woman's modesty.
punishment: Up to 1 year or fine or both

title: Causing disappearance of evidence
description: Punishes destruction or concealment of evidence.
punishment: Up to 7 years and fine

title: Rash driving
description: Punishes rash or negligent driving on a public way.
punishment: Up to 6 months or fine or both
